description: This is a Java test class for the CohortEditor component in the OpenMRS project. It extends a base test class and verifies the behavior of CohortEditor using a predefined dataset.

classes.name: CohortEditorTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing CohortEditor functionality within the OpenMRS platform.
